turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the present continuous (am/is/are + -ing)?
turns.tutor:
Hello! To say what people are doing now, use am/is/are + verb with -ing. Example: A boy is running in the park.

Exercise 1. Imagine a park. Write two sentences about what people are doing now.
